prompt.original: Use `brand-storytelling`. Company: we’re building a SOC2 automation tool. Audience: seed investors. Channels: pitch + podcast. Desired perception: credible, technical, direct, relentless. Raw material: I spent 18 months leading audits; the turning point was watching a team miss a launch because evidence was scattered. Proof: 3 design partners, 40% less audit prep time. Output: Brand Storytelling Pack.
